name: Saint-Jean-d'Aulps
description: Saint-Jean-d'Aulps sits in the Vallée d'Aulps at the foot of the Roc d'Enfer. Its own Roc d'Enfer ski area offers 50km of runs (31 slopes, 970-1,800m) in a wild, natural setting with forest runs, the Combe de Graydon cirque, and views of the Dents du Midi, Mont Blanc, and Lake Geneva. The 11th-century Abbey of Aulps (Cistercian) and the Vallée d'Aulps Discovery Centre (in the former monastic farmhouse) provide cultural depth. A shuttle bus links to the full 600km Portes du Soleil. Quiet, convivial, unspoilt.

overview.atmosphere: Traditional village in the Aulps valley. Roc d'Enfer ski area (50km, 31 runs) in a wild setting at the foot of the majestic Roc d'Enfer. 11th-century Cistercian abbey. Linked by shuttle to the full Portes du Soleil. Peaceful, authentic, unspoilt.

beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Snowshoeing, dog sledding, walking trails, heritage discovery. Peaceful, family-friendly atmosphere.

honest_drawbacks: Small local ski area (50km) — shuttle needed for full PDS
Lower altitude — snow variable at valley level
Limited dining/activities compared to larger resorts
